Body.Content:
The following updates are available on the Azure support portal:
  • Node.JS parser: Added data collector and parser for Node.JS applications in DaaS
  • AutoHeal UX for Execution Delay settings: Exposed ability to configure delaying auto healing rules on process start up in support portal
  • Crash diagnostics: Release site extension to help debug crashes and specific exceptions in Antares
For more information, see: Use Crash Diagnoser Site Extension to Capture Dump for Intermittent Exception issues or performance issues on Azure Web App.
Body.Markdown:
The following updates are available on the Azure support portal:

Node.JS parser :

Added data collector and parser for Node.JS applications in DaaS

AutoHeal UX for Execution Delay settings :

Exposed ability to configure delaying auto healing rules on process start up in support portal

Crash diagnostics :

Release site extension to help debug crashes and specific exceptions in Antares

For more information, see: Use Crash Diagnoser Site Extension to Capture Dump for Intermittent Exception issues or performance issues on Azure Web App .
